entities.summary: Brandon Jay Costner is an American former professional basketball player, currently a Retired. He most recently played for Puerto Rican teams Grises de Humacao and Santeros de Aguada of the Baloncesto Superior Nacional. He played college basketball for the NC State Wolfpack.
